newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor to sell Compass shares.
newsitem.headline: Accor to sell Compass shares.

text.p: Accor said in a statement that it had received permission from Compass to sell an 11.5 percent stake in the company or about 36,500,000 nominal shares at five pence each.
It said that Dresdner Kleinwort Benson was coordinating the placement with institutional investors and was running a bid book from 1430 GMT today until at latest 1200 GMT on Friday.
Accor said that it had obtained the Compass shares after it sold catering group Eurest to Compass in September 1995.
Accor said a new deal between Compass and it concluded today would allowed it to reduce its stake to 10 percent.
It has agreed not to go below 10 percent for 12 months.
After that, each sale of more than a five percent stake during a 12-month period needs approval by Compass.
The upward limit on Accor's stake, if it were to buy in the market at a given time, was put at 11 percent.
